I don't have money to spend on chemical fertilizer for root crops on rented land, especially since I never went to school and don't know much about those inputs. My family and I will do all the work ourselves — clearing, making the heaps, planting, weeding, and harvesting — because the plot is small enough for us to manage. We get good rain here in the southwest, so I don't need irrigation, and I will plant the traditional setts I saved from last season's harvest.
